thread:
emma_sales: Hey team, customer (FinAnalytica) wants a short POC — EU-only data residency + strict subprocessor list. They also asked if we can pin the tenant to eu-north-1 and have failover to eu-west-1 only (no us fallthrough). Pricing question too: will there be a surcharge for pinned tenancy vs our default hosted routing?

jordan_se: Quick answer: yes we can do tenant pin to eu-north-1 and restrict failover to eu-west-1, but it’s an ops task (routing + peering). Need confirmation on certs + subnet peering.

mike_security: From security side: we need the official subprocessor list and SOC2/HIPAA attestation flags. If they require no third-party CDNs in path we need to confirm our edge config. Also they asked for KMS in-region BYOK — is that in scope?

emma_sales: they do want BYOK for EU keys. Customer will push on that as a must-have for the POC.

lucas_ops: Ops notes: we can carve a dedicated tenant in eu-north-1 and set failover policy to eu-west-1 only. Work items: 1) create tenant route table 2) ensure regional peering certs 3) add routing policy to avoid global egress. Estimate 3-5 days to stand up for POC, +1 day for tests.

lisa_pricing: Pricing impact: hosted multi-region default = no surcharge. For tenant pin + reserved capacity in region we charge a regional isolation premium (roughly 20-30% on base reserved price) or usage uplift for hosted pinned tenancy. Also BYOK/in-region KMS add-on is a managed service fee. I can produce a ballpark.

anna_legal: Note: for an explicit subprocessor freeze we need a DPA amendment. Also if they prohibit certain subprocessors (e.g., FastEdge CDN) we must validate replacements. I can draft the amendment but will need a definitive subproc list they accept.

emma_sales: Customer also asked about egress billing when failover happens. If a request is routed to eu-west during peak (short window), does that trigger non-EU egress fees?

lucas_ops: No non-EU fees in that scenario. Egress stays within EU regions so billing stays EU. Only cross-border egress (to US/asia) would change billing.

jordan_se: For the POC we should provide a short runbook snippet for how we enforce residency and how we handle failover. Share that with customer for sign-off.

infra-bot: runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/poc-eu-tenant-pin (auto-generated snapshot) :white_check_mark:

jordan_se: Runbook snippet (paste)

```
# POC tenant pin + failover
tenant: finanalytica-poc
primary_region: eu-north-1
failover_regions: [eu-west-1]
subprocessors_allowed: ["AWS eu-north-1", "Vault (in-region KMS)"]
kv_cache: regional-only
routing_policy: strict-region-affinity
```

mike_security: Two asks for sec questionnaire: 1) subprocessor inventory CSV (incl. datacenter regions) 2) proof of in-region KMS & key rotation policy. I can attach our attestation doc.

emma_sales: Perfect. Action items: Jordan to produce the runbook + ops ticket, Lucas to estimate exact timeline & test plan, Lisa to send ballpark POC pricing and BYOK fee, Anna to prepare DPA amendment draft, Mike to attach attestation docs. I’ll coordinate customer sign-off and timeline.

lisa_pricing: I’ll post a simple pricing table in a follow-up message by EOD. :moneybag:

lucas_ops: Created ops ticket INF-7859 and linked runbook. ETA 4 days for provisioning + 24h validation window.

anna_legal: I’ll start a DPA draft and ping legal@ for expedited review.

emma_sales: Thanks all. I’ll update the customer after Lisa’s table. @jordan_se @lucas_ops please flag if any of the constraints (no-CDN, BYOK) push the timeline beyond 7 days.

jordan_se: Will do. small note: if they require IP allowlist-only access to the model endpoint, add 1 day for firewall rules.

emma_sales: noted. Thanks everyone! :pray:
